laws.rule: Gorilla tracking (Bwindi Impenetrable and Mgahinga): minimum age 15; at most eight visitors per gorilla group; do not track if you have a cold or other infectious illness; carry receipts and permits. Gorilla permits for foreign non-residents can only be booked through licensed tour operators.
laws.heading: Gorilla tracking rules; payments

sources.title: UWA Conservation Tariff July 2024 to June 2026
